hook_text: When your great-great-grandparents were children, a trip that takes you one hour by car could take them a whole week.
clip_script: A dusty road in the Eastern Cape, long ago. A family walks beside an ox-wagon, moving slowly, step by step. Then the picture changes: a steam train puffs through the hills. Then a minibus taxi hoots on a busy road. Then an aeroplane roars into the sky above the same hills. On land, on water and in the air, transport has changed. And every change has changed the way people live, work and visit each other.
visual_style: Whiteboard timeline from left to right: footprints, an ox-wagon, a steam train, a car, an aeroplane, with three labelled lanes for land, water and air.
mood: Curious and amazed, like opening an old photo album.
pacing: Quick jumps through time, then slow down for the big question at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and ask an older person how they travelled when they were young.
